expected_behavior: Each task runs in its own git worktree with its task file written to TASK.md, which is excluded from git and never merged.
Workers copy the project's untracked agent config — Crush's config, Claude Code's settings.local.json — into their worktree so they hold the user's rights, and that config never reaches a commit.
A task counts as failed only after every retry was used, and each retry starts from a clean worktree.
The script refuses to start when the working tree has uncommitted changes.
Every agent run is killed after the timeout; no worker runs unbounded.
The worker can be Claude Code, Codex, Crush or a custom command, and a custom command receives the prompt through the environment, never through the shell's parser.
